profile.input_contract: JSON surrogate criticality parameters with particles, absorption, and production.
profile.output_contract: JSON scalar observables k_eff, sigma_k, and reaction_balance.
profile.adapter: Cloud-safe Python runner and JSON parser/adapter under SUT/minimum_mr_subset_p9/; this is explicitly not a live OpenMC binding.

mrs.description: P9 OpenMC-style surrogate live launcher slice: scaling particle count leaves k_eff deterministic but reduces sigma_k by the Monte-Carlo 1/sqrt(N) trend. The runnable assertion checks sigma_k contraction while the ID preserves the imported k_eff noise-aware MR provenance.

explanation_profile.meta_pattern_rationale: Conv MR: larger particle count lowers the deterministic sigma_k surrogate following the 1/sqrt(N) trend.
explanation_profile.transformation_semantics: Apply ScaleField at /params/particles with factor > 1; absorption and production remain fixed so k_eff remains deterministic.
explanation_profile.observable_summary: Observe scalar `sigma_k`; the runner also emits imported observables `k_eff` and `reaction_balance` for provenance parity.
explanation_profile.predicate_summary: Predicate `less` / `LessThan` checks that follow-up sigma_k is smaller than source sigma_k.
explanation_profile.tolerance_summary: Ordinal predicate: no numeric tolerance is applied beyond the declared ordering relation.
explanation_profile.applicability: Applicable to the cloud-safe Minimum-MR-SubSet P9 surrogate sample under SUT/minimum_mr_subset_p9/sample/canonical.json; it is not a live OpenMC execution.
explanation_profile.failure_meaning: Failure indicates that the P9 runtime promotion, adapter mapping, or particle-count convergence contract disagrees with the staged import metadata.
